description: This file defines a Gradle plugin class for configuring Jacoco code coverage conventions in an Android library module. It applies the Jacoco plugin and configures it with extensions specific to Android libraries.

classes.name: AndroidLibraryJacocoConventionPlugin
classes.description: A Gradle plugin class that applies Jacoco and configures it for Android library projects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the Jacoco plugin and configures Jacoco for the project using specific Android library extensions.
